title: Simple Web Server Web Application manifest configuration schema (web.json)
description: Schema for defining a web application in the Simple Web Server. This configuration file is used to specify servlets and their mappings.

servlet-name.description: A unique name for the servlet, used for mapping.

servlet-class.description: The fully qualified class name of the servlet. This class must implement the kr.nerdlab.server.servlet.Servlet interface.

init-params.description: Optional initialization parameters for the servlet, passed to the servlet's init() method.

servlet-name.description: The name of the servlet to map. This must match a 'servlet-name' from the servlets list.

url-pattern.description: The URL pattern to map to the servlet. It must start with a '/'.

display-name.description: A human-readable name for the web application.

servlets.description: A list of servlet definitions for this web application.

servlet-mappings.description: A list of servlet mappings to URL patterns.
